memory_update.text: ALM is the primary US-listed reference name for non-Chinese tungsten mine supply and planned tungsten oxide capacity; track but do not treat as underfollowed after CNBC/current-media attention.
KMT is the best underfollowed second-order candidate because it maps to tungsten carbide powders, defense tungsten solutions, penetrators, armor, and industrial tooling rather than to mining screens.

UAMY has tungsten optionality through Fostung, but current evidence shows exploration/resource-stage exposure with no Ontario commercial extraction or processing in 2025; keep as speculative shadow until development evidence improves.

TUNGF is a micro-cap speculative exception: possible direct US tungsten restart plus GTP LOI, but must be filtered hard for resource validity, financing, first production, binding offtake, and downstream qualification.

The US-listed universe lacks obvious pure-play APT processors because major US tungsten processors such as Global Tungsten & Powders and Elmet Technologies appear private; public exposure is mostly upstream miners/explorers or downstream carbide/tooling companies.

Layer 2 should separate three subnodes: mine/concentrate supply, APT/tungsten oxide/powder processing, and defense-qualified carbide/heavy-alloy components. The investable bottleneck may sit more in processing/qualification than ore ownership.

node: Tungsten APT processing and non-Chinese defense-qualified tungsten supply
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the tungsten APT / non-Chinese defense-qualified tungsten node found a narrow US-listed universe. The strongest direct public-market mapping is Almonty, which is now Nasdaq-listed and tied to non-Chinese tungsten mine supply plus a planned tungsten oxide facility. Kennametal is the cleaner second-order downstream processor / carbide / defense-materials candidate: it is not a miner, but it appears closer to defense-qualified tungsten powders, penetrators, armor, and carbide tooling. United States Antimony and American Tungsten are speculative shadow candidates: both have tungsten project exposure, but the evidence is upstream/pre-production and must survive resource, permitting, processing, offtake, and customer-qualification checks.
